races.paceDynamic: Rebel Queen stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will likely dictate terms throughout, setting a sustainable gallop without pressure from fellow pace-setters. The heavily hold-up biased field creates a classic scenario where the leader can control fractions, potentially making life difficult for the pack of closers who will need the race to develop into a stamina test on this testing Heavy ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Queen establishes an uncontested lead and maintains strong jumping
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates ideal fractions and has enough in reserve to resist the late challenge from the hold-up horses who struggle to make up ground on the testing surface. The lack of early pace pressure allows sustainable galloping that suits her prominent style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closers Time It Right
scenarios.trigger: If the heavy ground and steady pace sets up perfectly for the hold-up brigade
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as the testing conditions find out Rebel Queen's stamina in the final half-mile. Codice and Shirzan emerge from the pack with perfectly timed runs that exploit the weakening leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly raced fillies shows significant improvement from their debut runs
scenarios.body: Ballyhahill, Look At You, or Shirleynightingale benefit from racing experience and handle the Heavy ground better than expected. The patient hold-up style proves effective against more exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Queen stops quickly and creates a messy finish where stamina becomes paramount
scenarios.body: The leader's effort tells dramatically turning for home, creating a scramble finish where the most resolute stayers prevail. Hunting Gold or Louie's Folly find extra reserves in testing conditions that suit their proven stamina.

watchPoints.text: Rebel Queen's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when challenged could end her front-running advantage quickly.
Codice handling the step back up to 2m on Heavy ground after recent shorter distance runs on faster surfaces.
The three lightly raced fillies Ballyhahill, Look At You, and Shirleynightingale for any market confidence suggesting hidden improvement.
Eitilt and Boogie Inthejungle both showing tendencies to fade - watch for early signs of weakening in the final half-mile.
How quickly the hold-up horses can organize their challenges if Rebel Queen dictates slow fractions early.

races.paceDynamic: Manoir De Mirande will dictate from the front with minimal pressure, as only Crooked Path offers consistent prominency while the rest are predominantly hold-up types. The heavy ground and lack of pace pressure should create a sustainable gallop that favors strong stayers, with the real race beginning when the back markers try to close from the 3f pole.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Manoir De Mirande maintains his jumping and isn't seriously challenged for the lead
scenarios.body: He can dictate his own fractions and kick clear approaching the last, making it difficult for the hold-up horses to reach him on heavy ground. The lack of pace pressure plays perfectly into his hands with stamina reserves intact.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and bunches the field turning for home
scenarios.body: The stronger finishers can overcome the tactical disadvantage and power through late on stamina-sapping heavy ground. One of the lightly-raced newcomers or proven heavy ground performers finds the necessary acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant mistakes at the business end hurdles
scenarios.body: The race becomes about who stays on their feet and maintains momentum rather than pure ability. Clean jumping becomes the decisive factor with ground conditions making recovery from errors more difficult.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three lightly-raced horses possesses hidden ability suited to these conditions
scenarios.body: The newcomer's fresh legs and unexposed stamina reserves prove superior to the more exposed runners who've shown their limitations. Heavy ground brings out untapped potential.

watchPoints.text: Monitor Pilgrims Walk and Folk Warrior for early signs of struggling as both have shown fading tendencies that heavy ground will worsen
Watch the early pace set by Manoir De Mirande - if too conservative it could bunch the field and negate his front-running advantage
Observe jumping technique of all runners carefully as heavy ground makes recovery from errors much more difficult
Keep eye on the three unknown quantities Fiveandahalf, Ivebeenkewadesert, and Trev The Rev for any signs of superior ability
Watch for Crooked Path to track Manoir De Mirande closely given his prominent style and excellent heavy ground record

races.paceDynamic: Listentomewillya stands as the only natural front-runner in this field, which should allow him to dictate terms without early pressure on the heavy ground. The majority of runners are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop, creating a tactical battle behind the leader where positioning at the final hurdle becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Listentomewillya Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader gets an easy time in front and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: Listentomewillya builds an insurmountable lead as the hold-up horses struggle to close on heavy ground. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to reserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run and the field stays competitive to two out
scenarios.body: The heavy ground takes its toll on Listentomewillya's stamina reserves while the classier hold-up horses find their rhythm. Endless Talking and Thisain'tthat benefit from their higher ratings in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Brackens Jet and El Phenomeno can track the leader without being trapped wide
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners get first run on the hold-up brigade while avoiding Listentomewillya's fate of making all the running. Their positioning advantage proves decisive as the backmarkers struggle to get involved.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fade simultaneously and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The combination of heavy ground and tactical riding sees the market leaders underperform as a lesser-fancied runner benefits from a perfect trip. The maiden nature of the contest allows an outsider to capitalize on others' misfortunes.

races.paceDynamic: Two confirmed front-runners in Rebel Cowgirl and Millie B will ensure an honest gallop from the start, though both carry warnings for fading in the finish which could create opportunities. The heavy going at this extended trip will test stamina severely, with 14 hold-up horses likely to converge in a bunched finish if the pace-setters weaken as expected.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If both Rebel Cowgirl and Millie B fade badly in the final half-mile as their profiles suggest
scenarios.body: The early leaders will set honest fractions but hit the wall approaching the final hurdle, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past. Shellrunforbriggs and Elsannah, both with strong heavy going records and stamina, will benefit most from the collapsing pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters maintain their effort longer than usual and keep the tempo honest to the line
scenarios.body: Rebel Cowgirl's recent win on soft ground and Millie B's durability will keep them competitive deeper into the race. The sustained pace will stretch the field and favor those with proven stamina on heavy going.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners like Roccabaker take over when the leaders begin to weaken approaching two out
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a tactical affair with the pace quickening dramatically in the final mile as fresher horses assert. This scenario suits horses that can adapt their running style and have a turn of foot on heavy ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Test Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the heavy going proves more testing than usual and only the strongest stayers survive the final furlong
scenarios.body: The combination of extended distance and heavy conditions will turn this into a true stamina examination where class matters less than durability. Horses with the best heavy going form and proven ability to see out this trip will prevail.

watchPoints.text: Rebel Cowgirl and Millie B both show clear fade patterns - if they go too fast early, the collapse could be dramatic
Dolly Watkins has faded badly in three of her last four starts and may not stay this extended trip
Walk In The Clouds won impressively last time on heavy but has a history of disappointing when favored
Westandtogether has a perfect heavy going record but this is a significant step up in class from recent wins
Nashville Notions has limited heavy going exposure which makes her hard to assess in these conditions

races.paceDynamic: Sophia Rose and Syracus Du Houx will likely share early duties as the only prominent runners, with Teescomponentsyess potentially tracking close behind. This creates a manageable pace that won't collapse, allowing the large hold-up contingent (9 horses) to get competitive from off the pace. The soft going suits this tactical setup, as stamina will tell over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Sophia Rose and Syracus Du Houx engage early and maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The pace becomes testing enough to find out the hold-up horses, with stamina and jumping under pressure becoming decisive factors. Duffys Hodey and Way Down South emerge best from the pack with their proven soft ground credentials.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too slow early and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the last fence, favoring horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina. Hello Jack and Malbas can quicken best despite their hold-up styles, with class telling over ground conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sophia Rose and Syracus Du Houx go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The leaders come back to the field dramatically, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the straight. Midnight Moonshine and Knockbrack Rambler benefit most from the strong pace setup despite starting from behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sophia Rose gets an uncontested lead and Teescomponentsyess tracks her perfectly
scenarios.body: The race develops into a battle between the early positioned horses, with the hold-up brigade left with too much to do. Teescomponentsyess outbattles Sophia Rose in the closing stages, with the pair clear of the rest.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic duel too hard early on the testing ground
scenarios.body: The pace setters weaken in the final half-mile as the hold-up brigade closes strongly. The highest-rated closers with best stamina reserves prevail in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco can rate kindly early while Doyen Magic forces the pace
